profile.headline: Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: Full Stack developer focused on Microsoft Technologies. I have been working with .net development since 2007. Today I am focused on progressive technologies, standards, and best practices that make the web better for everyone. I have been concentrating on .net core and modern java script frameworks; to make fast and wonderful experiences for everyone.

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description: At Ally Invest, I have been working on progressive technologies to deliver quality content to front end systems. Using SOLID principals, I spend time creating efficient and readable applications that I feel proud of.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
At SMA I maintain an asp.net web forms application. I build reports, fix bugs and add new features.
 Since I started working at SMA I have introduced new concepts to the development team. I have introduced the agile methodology. I have also introduced new technologies to our platform like node.js, react.js, mongodb, and asp.net web api.

I continue to make our practices and software better for everyone. We are a growing company and need new ways to handle new problems that present themselves with our ever changing environment.

positions.title: System Engineer
positions.description: Install and customize shipping applications for clients, fulfilling varying business needs.

positions.title: Integrated solutions support
positions.description: Work with Logistics management solutions such as SendSuite Express, and SendSuite Live. Support solutions engineers and clients when installing, customizing, or troubleshooting applications.

positions.title: Hardware support specialist
positions.description: I support customers with their hardware problems on Pitney Bowes products.

positions.title: Technical Support Specialist
positions.description:
Responsible for the care of various customer orders, maintenance of the network, setting up and maintaining various e-mail and Internet accounts. 
●Reposition customer's radio equipment so that they may have a better connection to 
  our SkyPilot network. 
●Set up many small business networks and solved many issues related to peoples 
 computers. 
●Resolve customer's PC related issues over the phone using VNC software. 
●Set up new SkyPilot EMS server.

positions.title: Owner

●Responsible for finding the customers through several different advertisement  
 campaigns. 
●Scheduled, repaired computers and billed customers.

positions.description: Responsible for the guest experience, helping guest with their purchases with a POS system. Ordered merchandise for the store.
